commits.summary: Bind generated numeric arguments and formats (verification pending)
commits.body:
Recover the frozen three-argument Spring parser with a locale-specific DecimalFormat or an explicit null formatter. JDI follows the JDK objects constructed by the caller and reads the text, target class and parsing mode at the original invocation. Existing two-argument callers retain identical Java source.

All 57 selected test suites passed. On the original JARs the previously blocked input yielded BigDecimal 1.5 and the grouping control returned 1.500 with German symbols and 1500 with US symbols. Job 20261126-230357-qualify-generated-formatted-numeric-call repeats all questions cold, warm and with an empty cache and challenges five equal-output argument substitutions.

commits.summary: Re-score measured open baselines offline (verification pending)
commits.body:
Record runtime stability through publication. Let a separate evaluation correct an original parent prediction when both original deployments provided complete repeated observations. Recheck the claim, bundle, side-specific witness and receipt. Preserve earlier adjudications and leave incomplete or unstable evidence open.

The archived CSS and Spring SSE questions each remained open with their original predicates, established with a corrected parent, and refuted with a deliberately incorrect fix. All three used the same original observations per question. Five missing or altered evidence controls per case lost qualification. The selected suites passed 57 of 57. Job 20261126-231202-re-score-a-lone-open-baseline-from-its-o tests the public command on a newly measured single question.
